# Glass UX

Typed React components, compound slots, themes and interaction rules. Read docs from the installed package to match its version.

Before composing UI, apply the screen content rules in docs/ui-rules.md. Unless explicitly
instructed otherwise: do not overuse subheadings, invent motivational or promotional copy,
overexplain the page, push primary content down with redundant framing, repeat a route title
already visible in navigation, or introduce content shifts that move buttons or menus.
